clips.title: The story
paras: Pelturas Whitemoon's desperate quest to heal his daughter Relara continues in Astranaar. While the sacred stone Elune's Tear calmed her terrifying nightmares, a fierce fever still grips her. Guided by Orendil Broadleaf's botanical knowledge, adventurers journey south to harvest a cooling, luminescent dust settled among ancient night elven stones.

Pelturas Whitemoon has spent sleepless nights by the bedside of his daughter, Relara, watching a malignant affliction burn through her. Though offering an Elune's Tear provided a temporary respite from the tormenting dreams that plagued her thoughts, the illness remains deeply rooted. Her body is racked by an intense fever that mundane medicines have failed to quench. With the temple healers pushed to their limits, Pelturas turns once more to ancient, nature-infused remedies to preserve his daughter's life.

On the advice of the elder herbalist Orendil Broadleaf, Pelturas looks toward the Ruins of Stardust, located south across the river from Astranaar. The fallen marble columns and archways of this ancient kaldorei sanctuary harbor a peculiar phenomenon: a frosted, shimmering substance that settles over the local foliage. This powdered condensation, colloquially termed stardust, possesses natural cooling properties potent enough to draw out unnatural heat. Pelturas intends to grind the collected residue into a medicinal poultice, hoping its tranquil chill will finally break Relara's burning fever.

Harvesting the frosted dust is perilous due to the guardians and wildlife inhabiting the flooded, sunken stones. Water elementals, corrupted or agitated by shifts in Ashenvale's balance, surge around the sunken plazas where the bushes grow thickest. Harvesters must wade into the tranquil-looking shallows while staying alert to sudden ambushes from the murky depths, scouring sparkling bushes for enough clean residue before rushing it back to Astranaar.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Elune's Tear washed clear some of my daughter's sickness. Her nightmares are lessened and I thank the goddess for her blessing. But... Fever still rages within her.
Orendil told me of a frosted dust found among the Ruins of Stardust. Perhaps it will abate Relara's fever. Gather some of the dust, then please return to me.
The Ruins of Stardust lie to the south, friend. May Elune speed your journey.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you yet have the Stardust, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You gathered the dust! I will create a poultice from these—it should bring down Relara's fever.
Thank you again, friend. Without your help, my child would surely perish.
